title: EnlightME
description: A simple datapack that makes you and your friends shine!
body:
# EnlightME datapack made by rossxrio 1.21.1 - 1.21.4

## Introduction

I made this simple datapack because I think it is useful to be able to make players **easy to find** over long-medium distances (especially if they are **new players**)
And it's **very easy to use**!!! (I think you should try it...)

## How to use

If for some reason is not working run  ```/function enlight:load```
> Syntax ```/function enlight:function {parameter1:value, parameter2: value}```

Function            | Usage                                                          | Description
------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------- | -----------
enlight:color       | ```/function enlight:color {name:*name*, color:*color*}```     | **name** you should use your user name, **color** is the **MINECRAFT** color
enlight:colorlist   | ```/function enlight:colorlist```                              | Show the available colors!
enlight:feedbackon  | ```/function enlight:feedbackon```                             | Turn on confirmation messages (On by default)
enlight:feedbackoff | ```/function enlight:feedbackoff```                            | Turn off confirmation messages (On by default)
enlight:load        | ```/function enlight:load```                                   | Load the datapack setup
enlight:unload      | ```/function enlight:unload```                                 | Unload the datapack setup
enlight:me          | ```/funtion enlight:me```                                      | Shine! (forever...)
enlight:off         | ```/function enlight:off```                                    | Shut off the shining
enlight:help        | ```/function enlight:help```                                   | Redirect you to this page
